about_short_description.short_description: Metric automates accounting for SMBs: track finances, get real-time insights, and formulate strategy – with zero finance experience.

product.name: Metric Financial Management App
product.description: A cloud-based app that automates accounting and financial tracking for small and medium businesses without requiring finance expertise.

product.name: One Picture Accounting
product.description: A feature that allows users to scan receipts or documents to automatically fill in transaction details for income, expenses, or withdrawals.

product.name: Invoice Generation and Management
product.description: A tool to create, personalize, and send invoices to customers directly from the app, including support for partial payments.

product.name: Financial Reporting and Analytics
product.description: Automated generation of financial reports such as profit and loss statements, income and expense reports, and founder reports, with export options.

product.name: Real-Time Financial Dashboard and Insights
product.description: A dashboard that displays up-to-the-minute financial metrics, industry trends, and personalized insights to support business decision-making.

product.name: Data Migration Service
product.description: A service to import previous financial data into the Metric app to ensure continuity and comprehensive financial tracking.
